h1: Custom Etched Caps for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom etched caps in bulk from Perfect Imprints. Ideal for corporate gifts and team branding. Get a quote today.
introHtml: Custom etched caps offer a durable, high-end look that stands out from standard embroidery or screen printing. The etching process creates a permanent, scratch-resistant design on the cap's bill or side panel, making it ideal for safety managers or brands that need long-lasting visibility. Choose from brushed metal or matte finishes for a refined, professional appearance that holds up to daily wear.
heroAltText: Custom etched caps with brushed metal finish and logo on bill, perfect for bulk corporate orders
